name: Stormbringer: Mystic Thunder silences a marked recast (#798)
contract: #798: Mystic Thunder 504846 reads "Interrupt the target's current spell cast and then mark them for $505214d. If they cast again while marked they are silenced for $505347d." Spell.dbc gives 504846 effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST (EffectMechanic 26) and effect 1 SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL on 505214, both TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, so the interrupt and the mark are stock core effects. 505214 has DurationIndex 28 (SpellDuration.dbc 28 = 5000 ms, the tooltip's 5 sec) and a single SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL(42) effect on 505347, but its ProcFlags is 0 and no spell_proc row exists, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it at SpellMgr.cpp:2256-2257 ('Skip if no proc flags in DBC') and 505347 was never cast. 505347 has DurationIndex 27 (SpellDuration.dbc 27 = 3000 ms, the tooltip's 3 sec) and one SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE(27) effect on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER. The fix casts 505347 from the marked unit itself on its next non-triggered cast and consumes the mark. The victim's second cast must be Drown 806407 (SchoolMask 16, Frost, CastingTimeIndex 1 = instant): Spell::EffectInterruptCast prohibits the interrupted spell's school for the interrupt spell's own duration (504846 DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms), which covers Call Lightning's Nature school for exactly as long as the mark lasts. Call Lightning 501398 has ManaCost/ManaCostPercentage 0 in Spell.dbc, so the mana fixture alone does not satisfy its cast requirement: AscensionCompatData::ResourceCostRules (AscensionCustomResourceData.h) has {16, 501388, 501399, 803102, 50, ResourceConsumption::Fixed}, and AscensionCompat::CheckCast (AscensionCompat.cpp:2320-2330) returns SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER when the caster's Static (803102) stacks are below the rule's Amount (50); a fresh fixture starts at 0 Static. The fix fixtures the victim to 100 Static stacks via set_aura before the Call Lightning cast, mirroring the Torrential Wrath/Deluge Static gate fix in stormbringer-fix-torrential-wrath-family-kinetic-energy.json.
